therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Epigenetic modulation and immune system activation in hematologic malignancies
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with relapsed or refractory lymphomas and myeloma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum tolerated dose and safety evaluation

results.effect_size: ORR: 22/49 participants responded across dose levels
subgroup_findings: Median duration of response: 15.7 months (95% CI: 4.1-26.2)
safety_signals: Acute kidney injury (2/36 at dose level 4)
Abdominal pain, ascites, atrial fibrillation among other SAEs
results.dose_information: Romidepsin IV on days 1, 8, 15 of 28-day cycle; Lenalidomide oral daily for 21 days of 28-day cycle; Dose level 4 was the recommended phase 2 dose

context.duration: Treatment cycles of 28 days, follow-up up to 50 months
